severity: integer 0..100, step 1. 0 copies the input. 100 has no recognizable original image.
gaussian_blur: GaussianBlur sigma = 1.5 * t/(1-t); t=1 is the per-channel mean
salt_pepper: each pixel becomes 255 or 0 with probability t/2 each; t=1 replaces every pixel
bilateral: bilateralFilter sigmaColor = 10.0 * t/(1-t), sigmaSpace = 2.0 * t/(1-t), diameter capped at 9; t=1 is the per-channel mean
